mapper.insert: insert into SIMULATION(USER_ID, SNAPSHOT_ID, SIMULATION_START_DATE, SIMULATION_DUE_DATE, SIMULATION_END_AMOUNT, EXPECT_PREP_MONTHS) values(#{userId}, #{snapshotId}, #{simulationStartDate}, #{simulationDueDate}, #{simulationEndAmount}, #{expectPrepMonths})
mapper.select: select * from SIMULATION where USER_ID = #{userId} and CONFIRMED_AT is null order by SIMULATION_ID desc limit 1
select * from SIMULATION where USER_ID = #{userId} and CONFIRMED_AT is not null order by CONFIRMED_AT desc, SIMULATION_ID desc limit 1
mapper.update: update SIMULATION set CONFIRMED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where SIMULATION_ID = #{simulationId} and CONFIRMED_AT is null
